correctness.rationale: For char(k) !=2 and lambda !=0, derivation relations force zero constants; off-diagonal W maps vanish except at lambda=-1, and D(z)=(a+e)z. In exterior case the operator matrix is [[M,0],[gamma,tr M]], with square-zero equivalent to M²=0 and gamma M=0; nonzero nilpotent 2x2 M has a one-dimensional image/kernel L, gamma annihilates L. Commutativity forces all nonzero M_i proportional using its 2x2 centralizer and all covectors in common Ann(L); hence every product D_iD_j=0. Incidence bundle over P1 has irreducible Y1 of dimension 2m+1, while M_i=0 yields Y0 affine 2m and intersection rank<=1 determinantal dimension m+1; m=1 Y0 inside Y1. Each nonzero derivation rank one. Finite-field line counting gives (Q+2)Q^(2m)-(Q+1)Q^m and the claimed rank-support product. Independent exhaustive F3 six-parameter enumeration found 33 square-zero derivations and 369 commuting ordered pairs, all mutually annihilating; arbitrary field/arity follows from the structural proof, not finite tests.
